neighbours.label: the word completing one of the fixed compounds 'natural-born' / 'natural born', 'historically black' or 'bio-identical' (not plain 'born', 'identical' or another X-born)
fire: Under the Constitution, the president must be a natural-born citizen of the country.
Everyone agreed that the girl was a natural-born storyteller.
My uncle was a natural born salesman who could sell ice in winter.
Howard is one of the best known historically black universities in the nation.
The grant supports science programs at historically Black colleges across the South.
Her grandfather taught chemistry at a historically black college in Alabama.
The pharmacy prepares bio-identical hormone creams for each patient.
Some doctors prescribe bio-identical estrogen during menopause.
quiet: Under the Constitution, the president must be at least thirty-five years old.
Everyone agreed that the girl was born to tell stories.
My uncle was born in a small town and sold ice in winter.
Howard is one of the best known private universities in the nation.
The grant supports science programs at historically poor colleges across the South.
Her grandfather was a Scottish-born chemist who taught in Alabama.
The pharmacy prepares identical hormone creams for each patient.
The two doctors wore identical black coats during the visit.

notes: A list, not a pattern: I found no shared rule. Probes also fired on 'Ecological Modelling' (0.92), weaker on 'foreign-born' / 'native-born' (0.4) and 'Experimental Medicine' (0.27); 'Irish-born', 'first-born', 'well-known' and 'self-made' read under 0.08. Journal names are not in this test.
